description: 夕方の落ち着いたカフェで、2人の友人が並んで座り、久しぶりの再会を楽しんでいる。左側の男性はスマートフォンに保存した旅行写真を見せながら笑顔で話し、右側の女性は写真を見ながら楽しそうに話を聞いている。テーブルには飲み終わりかけのコーヒー、デザートを食べ終えた皿、ナプキン、テーブル番号の札が置かれている。背景には大きな窓、街の景色、観葉植物、花や写真立てが並ぶ棚があり、暖かく落ち着いたカフェの雰囲気が感じられる。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test, inspired by a cozy modern cafe photograph. Show exactly two adult friends sitting closely beside each other at a small round cafe table in the early evening. Do not include any additional visible people. The atmosphere should be warm, relaxed, friendly, comfortable, and natural. On the left, an adult man with short dark hair is sitting casually on a wooden chair. He is smiling and holding a smartphone slightly toward his friend, showing her several travel photographs on the screen while talking about them. On the right, an adult woman wearing glasses is sitting beside him with a relaxed posture. She is smiling warmly, looking at the smartphone, and listening with interest. Make their interaction clearly look like two friends catching up after not seeing each other for some time. On the small round table in front of them, place two partly finished drinks, one coffee cup and one glass, two small dessert plates with only a few crumbs remaining, folded napkins, a spoon, and a clearly visible simple table-number card marked 7. Include a modern cafe interior inspired by the reference photograph: warm wooden flooring, elegant hanging pendant lights, a large street-facing window, decorative shelving with small plants, dried flowers, framed pictures, pottery, and simple ornaments. Through the window, show an evening street with shops and trees, but do not include clearly visible pedestrians. The main story should be the two friends sharing travel photos and enjoying conversation, while the finished drinks and dessert plates suggest that they have been talking for some time. Exactly two visible people. No additional people, no animals, no speech bubbles, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style with realistic proportions, highly detailed but uncluttered, expressive natural facial expressions and body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.

sentences.text: The two friends appear to be reconnecting over drinks in a relaxed and inviting cafe.
sentences.ja: 2人の友人は、居心地のよいカフェで飲み物を楽しみながら久しぶりの交流を深めているようです。

sentences.text: The man is showing his companion photographs on his smartphone, presumably while recounting a recent journey.
sentences.ja: 男性は、おそらく最近の旅行について話しながら友人にスマートフォンの写真を見せています。

sentences.text: His animated expression suggests that he is enthusiastic about sharing the experience with her.
sentences.ja: 彼の生き生きとした表情から、その経験を彼女と共有することを楽しんでいることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: The woman is listening attentively and appears genuinely engaged in the conversation.
sentences.ja: 女性は注意深く話を聞き、会話に心から興味を持っているようです。

sentences.text: Their relaxed posture and warm smiles indicate a comfortable sense of companionship.
sentences.ja: リラックスした姿勢と温かな笑顔から、2人の親しい関係が感じられます。

sentences.text: The nearly empty dessert plates imply that they have already spent a considerable amount of time talking.
sentences.ja: ほぼ空になったデザート皿から、2人がすでにかなりの時間を話して過ごしていることがうかがえます。

sentences.text: They may be lingering over their drinks because neither of them appears eager to end the conversation.
sentences.ja: どちらも会話を終えたそうには見えないため、飲み物を楽しみながらゆっくり過ごしているのかもしれません。

sentences.text: The decorative shelving, plants, pendant lighting, and street-facing window contribute to the cafe's sophisticated yet inviting ambience.
sentences.ja: 飾り棚、植物、ペンダント照明、通りに面した窓が、洗練されながらも居心地のよいカフェの雰囲気を作っています。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how an ordinary meeting over coffee can provide an opportunity to reconnect, exchange experiences, and strengthen a personal relationship.
sentences.ja: この場面は、カフェでの何気ない再会が、交流を深め、経験を共有し、人間関係を強める機会になり得ることを示しています。
